title.en: The Connector module of the EU regulatory compliant Digital Product Passport Core Ontology (EU DPP CO) proposed by the CIRPASS-2 European project.

description.en:
Connector (Bridge) module that only defines object properties between modules. The connector contains only object properties that have domain and range specified in different modules.

It gives the current status only; the history of changes is represented with the events.

comment.en:
Specifies the EU declaration of conformity issued for the product.

EUDeclarationOfConformity is modelled in the EU DPP CO COMP module.
Product is modelled in the EU DPP CO P_DPP module.

Links a substance presence to concentration information. A concentration is contextual to the structural location identified by the associated SubstancePresence. 

Different product, component, or spare-part locations requiring different concentrations should normally use distinct SubstancePresence records. 

Exact, maximum, and range representations remain distinguished by the existing P_DPP/SOC concentration model.

ConcentrationOfSubstanceOfConcern is modelled in the EU DPP CO P_DPP module.
SubstancePresence is modelled in the EU DPP CO IDENT module.
